top_choice_rationale: P001 gives targeted protein degradation as the whole prize to Crews, Deshaies and Handa. The citation rests on a chemical principle, small-molecule-induced ligase-target ternary complexes and event-driven catalysis, and joins the PROTAC concept with the identification of cereblon, which explains established glue drugs. Its validity and reproduction are undisputed. P002 is a close second: Ciulli's structure-guided design is real, but the narrower bifunctional-only citation leaves the cereblon mechanism unexplained. P003 spends a seat on base editing, which follows the 2020 prize closely and is clinically young, and drops Handa. A prize is still better than no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; Stockholm University colleague of Xiaodong Zou, whose preferred part is not in the top-ranked proposal; no tie to any proposed laureate
